collection.title: Vauxhall Vivaro 2019 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Vauxhall Vivaro 2019 Onwards model requires a 26" wiper blade for the drivers and a 20" on the passengers side with a Bayonet arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle.
